english.note: Use this when “unkind” means ungrateful: someone fails to appreciate or repay kindness received.

examples.english: They helped him so much before, but now he acts as if they do not exist; that is really unkind.
examples.traditional: 人哋以前咁幫佢，而家佢竟然當人哋冇到，真係忘恩負義。
